text: 9月24日，苏州住房公积金管理中心发布《关于支持装修提取住房公积金的通知》。其中提出，缴存人及其配偶在全国范围内无住房公积金贷款余额，对苏州市行政区域内自住住房进行装修的，可就名下同一套住房申请提取住房公积金。所有提取人累计提取额不超过房屋装饰装修增值税发票金额，且不超过15万元。个人住房公积金账户须至少按最新缴存基数留存一个月的缴存额（不含新职工补贴）。
text_en: On September 24, the Suzhou Housing Provident Fund Management Center issued the Notice on Supporting Housing Provident Fund Withdrawals for Renovation. It proposed that if depositors and their spouses have no outstanding housing provident fund loan balance nationwide and renovate self-occupied housing within the administrative area of Suzhou, they may apply to withdraw housing provident fund for the same property under their names. The cumulative withdrawal amount of all withdrawers shall not exceed the amount on the value-added tax invoice for housing decoration and renovation, and shall not exceed 150,000 yuan. The individual housing provident fund account must retain at least one month's deposit amount based on the latest deposit base (excluding new employee subsidies).
